method: Parse each linked Python test file with Python AST. Compare source-linked callable leaves to call expressions, separately flag generic leaves. Record the enclosing function, syntactic Assert count, and same-file lexical helper-call reachability from test_* functions. Separately inventory Rust #[cfg(test)] blocks and #[test] names in linked source files, recording whether linked callable identifiers occur in the test tail. Python lexical reachability and Rust test-tail name presence do not establish runtime execution, assertion relevance, independent oracle use, production-path coverage, or branch execution.
